# T005: Add session tests

## Goal
When this task is done, the session store and the refresh logic have an end-to-end test that signs in, waits for the refresh window, calls `/api/me` and checks the new deadline.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a running app and a registered user, When the test signs in and calls `/api/me` inside the refresh window, Then `expiresAt` moved forward.
- Given the same run, When the test calls `/api/logout` and then `/api/me`, Then the second call is 401.

## Target files
- test/auth/session.test.ts
- test/auth/refresh.test.ts

## Contracts
- contracts/auth-api.md

## Out of scope
- Any change under `src/`.

## Notes for the worker
Use the test app factory from `test/helpers/app.ts` and a fake clock; never sleep.
